LanguageData.AC_PowderedMineral.description:
Powdered mineral is finely ground metal, produced from gold, silver, steel, and other ores. While it lacks practical applications, it is valued as a trade good, often prized for its rarity, sheen, or symbolic worth in various cultural exchanges.
<color=#E5E54C>Trade considerations:</color>
<color=#E5E54C>Ingredients:</color> Making 5 powdered mineral requires 15 minerals for a total value of 28.5 (assuming steel, other minerals will adjust recipe yield depending on their market value), and sells for 15, giving a <color=#33CC33>62%</color> profit per unit.
<color=#E5E54C>Value per work:</color> Recipe requires 5000 work, which results on a value per work of <color=#33CC33>0.02</color>.
<color=#E5E54C>Caravan trading:</color> Its weight is 0.05 Kg, for a value per Kg of <color=#33CC33>500</color>.
<color=#E5E54C>Profit per day:</color> Profit per day is hard to estimate, as it depends on how much mineral you can mine.
LanguageData.AI_AdditionalBuoyancyVacuoles.descriptio:
An animal additional buoyancy vacuoles implant that inserts several hydrogen filled structures inside the animals' body, allowing it to gently glide a few feet in the air. This will negate all terrain movement costs.
NOTE: This implant will have no effect on animals that possess this ability innately, such as Aerofleet.
LanguageData.Apparel_ConscriptFatigues.description: A standard-issue conscript fatigues. Inexpensive and ease of maintenance, production and durability.
LanguageData.BM_SpacerBiowelderUtilityModule.descript: A high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any compatible artificial heart replacement. This particular model frequently releases a small swarm of biowelder mechanites throughout the host's body, greatly increasing the rate at which their wounds heal.
LanguageData.BM_SpacerCoagulatorUtilityModule.descrip: A high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any compatible artificial heart replacement. This particular model releases coagulating factors in response to blood loss, reducing bleeding rate significantly.
LanguageData.DNX_MiningDrone.description: An experimental drone for testing the automatic digging process in deep ore veins. It flies to the nearest scanned deep mineral and keeps mining it. It has no built-in battery or charging logic yet.
LanguageData.DNX_MiningDrone.label: experimental mining drone
LanguageData.Elgo_MeleeWeapon_Alphablade.description: A blade made by grinding an Alpha Slamboo horn and fitting it with a high-frequency conduction mechanism to improve its cutting power. Listen closely and you can hear a tuning-fork-like vibration.
LanguageData.Elgo_MeleeWeapon_Alphablade.label: alpha blade
LanguageData.Elgo_MeleeWeapon_Alphasword.description: A tactical greatsword: an Alpha Slamboo horn shaped into a blade and built into a grip with a high-frequency conduction mechanism. Normally its gray blade resonates with the high frequency and glows red.
LanguageData.Elgo_MeleeWeapon_Alphasword.label: alpha sword
LanguageData.Elgo_MeleeWeapon_whiteblade.description: A sword carved from a Slamboo horn, with a grip made for easy handling. Light, easy to wield, and very sharp.
LanguageData.Elgo_MeleeWeapon_whiteblade.label: slamboo horn katana
LanguageData.Elgo_MeleeWeapon_whitesword.description: A melee weapon made by fusing the core of a Slamboo horn and grinding it into a greatsword. It has both cutting and crushing power.
LanguageData.Elgo_MeleeWeapon_whitesword.label: slamboo greatsword
LanguageData.Gun_RSBattleRifle.description: Big cousin of assault rifles, the battle rifles higher-caliber rounds provide greater power and range, though they have greater weight and produce stronger recoil, making them less than ideal for fully automatic fire.
LanguageData.Gun_TripleRocket.description:
A single-use rocket launcher that fires a cluster of three large-bore explosive rockets. Good against small groups of tough targets.
Because of its unwieldiness, single-use limitation, and the massive destruction it causes, it's said that one must be slightly crazy to use this weapon.
LanguageData.LTS_ArchotechHeart.description: An artificial heart built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but can somehow pump far more blood throughout the body without putting additional strain on the cardiovascular system. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.
LanguageData.LTS_FireSupressionSystem.description: An implanted fire suppression system, designed to cover the user in firefoam when necessary. The device can be activated while the pawn is down, though it can only hold a limited number of charges and will need refueling with chemfuel between uses.
LanguageData.Mulli_gun.label: Mulli gun
LanguageData.No_Entery_Bar.label: No Entry Bar
LanguageData.PWL_Weapon_Welder.tools.1.label: electric arc
LanguageData.Seagull.description:
A resourceful, opportunistic medium-sized coastal bird. Easily identified by its gray and white feathers and loud calls, seagulls are aggressive scavengers that frequent maritime coastlines, islands, and wetlands, trailing behind fishing operations and coastal settlements to squabble over scraps.
Pejoratively referred to as "beach chickens," "garbage gulls," "dump ducks," and other even worse names, these birds are often hated for their raucous squawking and propensity to create huge messes while stealing food even right from a colonist's hands.
LanguageData.Trinity_Bench.description: A bench with a distinctive backrest design.The cushions are very soft.
LanguageData.VGE_Turret_DefenderTurret.description: An armored security turret containing a built-in power source.
LanguageData.VQE_ShufflerDrone.description: A broken, decommissioned sentry drone. Its fried sensors and failing components cause it to shuffle aimlessly. Despite its derelict state, it will attack any targets it sees. Upon taking severe damage, its chassis splits into two smaller, relentless attacking drone units.
LanguageData.VWE_MeleeWeapon_Halberd.description:
Halberd is a pike fitted with a light axe head. Due to the spear-like sharp tip, it's a great tool against armored enemies.
Used to fight down horse-mounted warriors in medieval times thanks to its extraordinary length.
LanguageData.Velvet_Chair.label: Velvet Chair
LanguageData.YP_Seu.description:
An assassin's weapon, it unleashes a massive amount of armor-piercing shards from very close range. It has a secondary ability that can make the user invisible for a short period of time.
Yeonhwa Precision Special Purpose Combat Infiltration System Model 3792a. Seu (Mist Rain).
Another example of the Haranas' technological prowess, this modified shard rifle fires a torrent of mechanite-infused, semi-intelligent crystal shards. The weapon itself has a limited range and is difficult to use, but the user can use the built-in optical mechanite sprayer to make themselves invisible for a short time. When you're invisible to your enemies, the limited range is no big deal.
